S11.03.note: Only the slash command list was checked for arrow and Esc handling; other menus were not checked.
steps: Run agi in Terminal and wait for the input box.
With the input box empty, type / . The command list opens.
Press the Down arrow key a few times, then the Up arrow key. The highlighted row should move.
Type a few letters to filter the list, then press Esc. The list should close and the input should be ready again.
Compare with Expected: every step should work with the keyboard only.

S11.04.note: The only focus cue found in code is the ❯ text marker; no colour or style for focus was found.
steps: Run agi and type / with the input box empty to open the command list.
Press the Down arrow key once.
Look for the marker ❯ at the start of the highlighted row. It should move to the new row.
Compare with Expected: the focused row should be clearly visible, not just a faint change.

S11.14.note: Code does not read the OS reduced-motion preference; it only reads this app setting or plain mode. The setting is applied at start (apps/cli/src/tui/tui_app.rs:7122), not live when changed.
steps: Run agi and type /config set reduced-motion true, then press Enter.
Type /config and press Enter. The output should show the line Reduced motion: true.
Quit agi with Ctrl+D and start agi again, because the setting is read only at start.
Send a message and watch the waiting spinner and the moving shine on text. With the setting on, the spinner should stay as one still dot and the shine should not sweep.
Compare with Expected: looping and moving animation should stop or be replaced.
S11.14.where: agi (full-screen screen), then type /config set reduced-motion true, then /config to check

S11.16.needs: a microphone, and agreement to voice mode
S11.16.note: The transcript is kept only as the chat message that was sent; no separate transcript file or saved transcript view was found in voice.rs.
steps: Run agi and type /voice, then press Enter.
Read the agreement prompt and press Enter to agree.
Press SPACE, speak a sentence, and follow the on-screen prompt to stop recording.
Read the line You said: and press Enter to send it.
Compare with Expected: the sent words should appear as a message in the chat, and can be read back later in that chat.
S11.16.where: agi (full-screen screen), then type /voice and press Enter

S11.23.needs: a Free or paid account for the /cost step
S11.23.note: Money in session cost lines is shown as credits (for example 1 credit), not dollars. The dollar sign appears only in the pricing report from agi --cost.
steps: In Terminal, run agi --cost.
Read the Input: and Output: lines. Each should show a dollar sign and /1M tokens.
Start agi, send one short message, then type /cost and press Enter.
Compare with Expected: session totals show Tokens: ... with the word credits, not a currency symbol, and large numbers should have comma grouping.
S11.23.where: Terminal: agi --cost (prints the pricing report); then inside agi: /cost

steps: Run agi in a wide Terminal window and note the bottom status line.

S11.28.note: NO_COLOR alone does not turn on plain mode (apps/cli/src/output.rs:33); it is checked only in the colour detection at apps/cli/src/output.rs:100, not verified on every output path.
steps: In Terminal, run agi --plain. The app should use the line-based screen, not the full-screen layout.
Type a short message and check that there are no coloured words, no animated spinner frames and no redrawn screen.
Quit, then run NO_COLOR=1 agi --cost and check that the pricing report has no colour.
Compare with Expected: plain output has no colour, spinners or redraws, and NO_COLOR removes colour.
